scripts.deploy:alpha: node scripts/nexus-platform.mjs use alpha && npm run build-web && nexus deploy --non-interactive --no-verify -e development
scripts.deploy:rc: node scripts/nexus-platform.mjs use rc && npm run build-web && nexus deploy --non-interactive --no-verify -e development
scripts.build-custom-ui: npm run build --prefix web/button && npm run build --prefix web/pages && npm run build --prefix web/cards && npm run build --prefix web/background && npm run build --prefix web/dynamic-content
scripts.build-web: npm run build-native && npm run build-custom-ui
